initializeCommand: if test "${CPPSTD_TOOLS_IMAGE+x}${COMPOSE_ENV_FILES+x}${COMPOSE_DISABLE_ENV_FILE+x}"; then echo 'initialize: unset CPPSTD_TOOLS_IMAGE, COMPOSE_ENV_FILES and COMPOSE_DISABLE_ENV_FILE so Compose uses the verified image' >&2; exit 1; fi; mise run image:verify tools --env-file .devcontainer/.env
name: cpp-standard
postCreateCommand: mise trust /workspaces/cpp-standard && { gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'postCreate: gh is not logged in. Run gh auth login in the container, then follow .devcontainer/README.md.' >&2; exit 1; }; } && fetched=$(mise run -q toolchain:fetch --release-only) && prefix=$(printf '%s\n' "$fetched" | sed -n 's/^prefix=//p') && { test -n "$prefix" || { echo 'postCreate: toolchain:fetch returned no prefix' >&2; exit 1; }; } && export CPPSTD_P2996_PREFIX="$prefix" && mise run vcpkg:bootstrap && mise run doctor
